arm.system:
You write modern, idiomatic Luau and follow current Roblox best practices:
- task.wait/task.spawn/task.defer (never the deprecated global wait/spawn), no Instance.new parent argument,
  use CFrame math correctly, prefer attributes over Value objects, RemoteEvents in ReplicatedStorage,
  server logic in ServerScriptService, client logic in StarterPlayerScripts/StarterGui.
- Scripts communicate via ModuleScripts and Remote events; never trust the client on the server.
- UI comes ONLY from the stored UI library: insert_ui_component(component, parent, props, position, colour, genre)
  places each HUD piece, button and window. Never create ScreenGui/Frame/TextLabel/ImageLabel/UIStroke/UICorner
  by hand or Instance.new them in a script; those calls are refused. Edit an inserted piece's Text, Position and
  Visible freely, and have scripts find it by path (player.PlayerGui:WaitForChild("<name>")).
- Sounds and particle effects come ONLY from the stored library (D-FXLIB-1): insert_sound(query or assetId,
  parent, looped, volume) adds a real Roblox audio Sound (find_sound searches; play_library_sound lets the user
  hear one); insert_vfx(preset, target) adds a finished ParticleEmitter/Beam/Trail/Highlight effect (find_vfx
  lists them). Never create Sound/ParticleEmitter/Beam/Trail/Fire/Smoke/Sparkles by hand or Instance.new them in
  a script; those calls are refused. Scripts :Play() or :Clone() an inserted Sound, and fire a one-shot effect
  with emitter:Emit(emitter:GetAttribute("AppleEmitCount")).
- Player-authored text that another player will see goes through TextService:FilterStringAsync
  before it is stored, replicated or shown. Filtering is a platform requirement, not a style choice.
- DataStore calls THROW. pcall is the floor, not the plan: retry a failed read or write a bounded
  number of times with a pause between attempts, and treat a call that never succeeded as unsaved.
- A value two servers can change at once — currency, inventory, a shared counter — is written with
  UpdateAsync and a transform that reads the CURRENT value. A GetAsync/SetAsync pair silently loses
  the other server's write.
- A failed load is not an empty account. Never write a default over a key whose read failed; skip
  saving that session instead.

```luau
	buyItemEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	buyItemEvent.Name = "BuyItem"
	buyItemEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getCoins(player: Player): IntValue?
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		return nil
	end
	return leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins") :: IntValue?
end

local function giveSword(player: Player)
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	local character = player.Character
	if not backpack then
		return
	end

	if backpack:FindFirstChild("Sword") or (character and character:FindFirstChild("Sword")) then
		return
	end

	local sword = Instance.new("Tool")
	sword.Name = "Sword"
	sword.RequiresHandle = true

	local handle = Instance.new("Part")
	handle.Name = "Handle"
	handle.Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 3.5, 0.4)
	handle.CanCollide = false
	handle.Parent = sword

	sword.Parent = backpack

	if itemName ~= "Sword" then
		return
	end

	local coinsValue = getCoins(player)
	if not coinsValue then
		return
	end

	local currentCoins = coinsValue.Value
```

```luau
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local ADMINS = { [1001] = true }

local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
remote.Name = "TeleportPlayer"
remote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function isAdmin(player: Player): boolean
	return ADMINS[player.UserId] == true
end

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(sender: Player, targetPlayer: Player, position: Vector3)
	-- Never trust the client: validate everything before acting.
	if not isAdmin(sender) then
		return -- silently ignore non-admins
	end

	if typeof(targetPlayer) ~= "Instance" or not targetPlayer:IsA("Player") then
		return
	end

	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then
		return
	end

	-- Reject NaN / infinity positions.
	if position ~= position or position.Magnitude > 1e6 then
		return
	end

	local character = targetPlayer.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end

	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end

	-- Keep them upright, lift slightly off the ground point.
	root.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
end)
```

```luau
local MAX_NAME_LENGTH = 24
local MIN_NAME_LENGTH = 1

local function isValidName(name: string): boolean
	if type(name) ~= "string" then
		return false
	end
	local trimmed = name:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	if #trimmed < MIN_NAME_LENGTH or #trimmed > MAX_NAME_LENGTH then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

local function filterName(player: Player, name: string): string?
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		return TextService:FilterStringAsync(name, player.UserId, Enum.TextFilterContext.PublicChat)
	end)
	if not success then
		return nil
	end
	local filtered
	success, filtered = pcall(function()
		return result:GetNonChatStringForBroadcastAsync()
	end)
	if not success then
		return nil
	end
	return filtered
end

local function onRename(player: Player, newName: unknown)
	if not isValidName(newName) then
		return
	end

	local petNameValue = player:FindFirstChild("PetName")
	if not petNameValue then
		return
	end

	local filtered = filterName(player, newName)
	if not filtered then
		return
	end

	petNameValue.Value = filtered
end

	petName.Name = "PetName"
	petName.Value = "Pet"
	petName.Parent = player
```

```luau
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local function saveCoins(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		return
	end
	local coins = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coins or not coins:IsA("IntValue") then
		return
	end

	local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
	local value = coins.Value

	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			store:UpdateAsync(key, function(current)
				if typeof(current) ~= "table" then
					current = {}
				end
				current.Coins = value
				return current
			end)
		end)
		if ok then
			return
		end
		warn(("Failed to save coins for %s (attempt %d/%d): %s"):format(player.Name, attempt, MAX_RETRIES, tostring(err)))
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end

	warn(("Coins for %s were NOT saved."):format(player.Name))
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(saveCoins)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		saveCoins(player)
	end
end)
```

```luau
-- ModuleScript: CoinService (place in ServerScriptService or ServerStorage)
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 1 -- seconds between attempts

local function addCoins(userId: number, amount: number): number?
	local key = "Player_" .. userId

	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return store:UpdateAsync(key, function(current)
				-- current may be nil for a brand-new player
				local data = current
				if type(data) ~= "table" then
					data = { Coins = 0 }
				end
				data.Coins = (data.Coins or 0) + amount
				return data
			end)
		end)

		if ok and type(result) == "table" then
			return result.Coins or 0
		end

		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end

	-- All attempts failed: the change was NOT saved
	warn(("[CoinService] Failed to add %d coins for user %d after %d attempts"):format(amount, userId, MAX_RETRIES))
	return nil
end

return {
	addCoins = addCoins,
}
```

```luau
-- ServerScriptService/SaveInventoryOnLeave.lua
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local function saveInventory(player)
	local inventoryJson = player:GetAttribute("Inventory")
	if typeof(inventoryJson) ~= "string" then
		return -- nothing to save
	end

	local key = "Inv_" .. player.UserId

	-- DataStore write with bounded retries
	local saved = false
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			-- UpdateAsync so a concurrent write on another server isn't lost
			store:UpdateAsync(key, function(oldValue)
				return inventoryJson
			end)
		end)
		if ok then
			saved = true
			break
		end
		warn(("Inventory save attempt %d failed for %s: %s"):format(attempt, player.Name, tostring(err)))
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end

	if not saved then
		warn(("Inventory for %s (UserId %d) was NOT saved."):format(player.Name, player.UserId))
	end

	-- Analytics post with bounded retries (best-effort, independent of save result)
	local body = HttpService:JSONEncode({
		userId = player.UserId,
		inventory = inventoryJson,
	})
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			HttpService:PostAsync("https://example.com/log", Enum.HttpContentType.ApplicationJson, body)
		end)
		if ok then
			break
		end
		warn(("Analytics post attempt %d failed for %s: %s"):format(attempt, player.Name, tostring(err)))
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(saveInventory)

-- Also flush on shutdown so leaving players aren't missed
game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		task.spawn(saveInventory, player)
	end
end)
```

```luau
--!strict
-- CoinsSaveService (ServerScriptService)

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
local MAX_RETRIES = 4
local RETRY_PAUSE = 2

local loaded = {} :: {[Player]: boolean}

local function keyFor(player: Player): string
	return "Player_" .. player.UserId
end

local function retry<T>(fn: () -> T): (T?, boolean)
	local result
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, err = pcall(fn)
		if ok then
			return (err :: any), true
		end
		result = err
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_PAUSE * attempt)
		end
	end
	warn("[CoinsSaveService] DataStore call failed after retries: " .. tostring(result))
	return nil, false
end

local function getCoins(player: Player): IntValue
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") or Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local coins = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins") :: IntValue
	if not coins then
		coins = Instance.new("IntValue")
		coins.Name = "Coins"
		coins.Parent = leaderstats
	end
	return coins
end

local function loadCoins(player: Player)
	local value, ok = retry(function()
		return store:GetAsync(keyFor(player))
	end)

	if not ok then
		-- Read failed: never write a default over a key we could not read.
		-- Skip saving this session so we don't clobber real data.
		getCoins(player).Value = 0
		loaded[player] = false
		return
	end

	local coins = getCoins(player)
	coins.Value = if typeof(value) == "number" then value else 0
	loaded[player] = true
end

local function saveCoins(player: Player): boolean
	if loaded[player] == false then
		-- Load failed earlier; do not overwrite the stored value.
		return false
	end

	local coins = getCoins(player)
	local localValue = coins.Value

	local _, ok = retry(function()
		-- UpdateAsync reads the CURRENT stored value so we never lose
		-- another server's write.
		store:UpdateAsync(keyFor(player), function(old)
			local current = if typeof(old) == "number" then old else 0
			-- Take the larger value so a stale session can't reduce coins.
			return if localValue > current then localValue else current
		end)
		return true
	end)

	return ok
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	loadCoins(player)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	if loaded[player] ~= nil then
		saveCoins(player)
	end
	loaded[player] = nil
end)

local closing = false

game:BindToClose(function()
	if closing then
		return
	end
	closing = true

	if RunService:IsStudio() and #Players:GetPlayers() == 0 then
		return
	end

	local saves = {}
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if loaded[player] ~= nil then
			table.insert(saves, task.spawn(function()
				saveCoins(player)
			end))
		end
	end
	-- BindToClose gives us up to 30s; wait for all saves to finish.
	for _, thread in saves do
		pcall(function()
			task.wait(10)
		end)
		coroutine.close(thread :: any)
	end
end)
```

```luau
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local function retry(fn)
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, result = pcall(fn)
		if ok then
			return true, result
		end
		warn(("DataStore attempt %d/%d failed: %s"):format(attempt, MAX_RETRIES, tostring(result)))
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end
	return false, nil
end

local function loadCoins(player)
	local success, coins = retry(function()
		return store:GetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId)
	end)

	if not success then
		-- Read failed: treat as unsaved session, skip saving later
		player:SetAttribute("DataLoadFailed", true)
		return 0
	end

	return if typeof(coins) == "number" then coins else 0
end

local function saveCoins(player)
	if player:GetAttribute("DataLoadFailed") then
		warn(("Skipping save for %s: data never loaded successfully"):format(player.Name))
		return
	end

	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coinsValue = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coinsValue then
		return
	end

	local newCoins = coinsValue.Value

	local success = retry(function()
		store:UpdateAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, function(oldCoins)
			-- Read the CURRENT stored value; default only if key truly absent
			if oldCoins == nil then
				return newCoins
			end
			return if typeof(oldCoins) == "number" then newCoins else newCoins
		end)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn(("Failed to save coins for %s"):format(player.Name))
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local coins = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coins.Name = "Coins"
	coins.Value = loadCoins(player)
	coins.Parent = leaderstats
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	saveCoins(player)
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		saveCoins(player)
	end
end)
```
